newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Water mulls Danone jv.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Water mulls Danone jv.

text.p: Shenzhen Health Mineral Water Co Ltd has been talking with French food groupe Danone about setting up a mineral water joint venture, an official of the Chinese company said on Wednesday.
The venture with Danone would be based in the southern Chinese boom city of Shenzhen, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The venture would help Shenzhen Health boost its annual production capacity to one million tonnes of mineral water by the year 2000 from about 150,000 tonnes currently, she said.
The official declined to disclose the investment involved or a timetable for the project.
Shenzhen Health has set a 45-million-yuan net profit target for 1997 and aims for turnover of 280 million yuan based on international accoutning standards, another official has said.
Shenzhen Health booked net profits of 33.97 million yuan in 1996 against 22.57 million in 1995 under international accounting standards.

Danone, a leading food group in France, has recently pumped the equivalent of 320 million yuan ($38.55 million) into a new brewery joint venture in China's central city of Wuhan, the Xinhua news agency has said.
The new Wuhan Euro-Dongxihu Brewery Co Ltd venture planned to introduce a state-of-the-art bottling line in the near future, the news agency said in May.
